title: SurvX: Survival, Competing Risks and Cure Regression Models
description: R package for survival and competing-risks analysis with a dependency-free C++ core: direct parametric models for the cumulative incidence function (Jeong-Fine joint PH/PO/GOR, the constrained model of Shi et al.), Fine-Gray and cause-specific Cox models, Aalen-Johansen estimation, parametric and cure models, interval-censored data (Turnbull estimator, parametric and direct CIF regression), shared gamma frailty, time-varying effects, adjusted risks by g-formula and inverse probability weighting, prediction performance (Brier, IPA, time-dependent AUC, calibration) and the simulation code of the accompanying article.
